title: Select only one arrival time slot
goal: uses fieldset and legend to organize a set of options, and implement single-selection mutual exclusion through the same name.
summary: Workshop morning and afternoon sessions can currently be selected at the same time. Add a group name to this group of time periods and change it to Choose One.
tasks: Use a fieldset to wrap the two options, and put "arrival time" into the legend at the beginning of the group.
Change the names of both radios to slot and keep the original values.
In the preview, click AM first, then PM. Finally only afternoon should be selected.

example.code:
<fieldset>
  <legend>seating area</legend>
  <label><input type="radio" name="seat" value="window">Window</label>
  <label><input type="radio" name="seat" value="aisle">by the aisle</label>
</fieldset>
example.note: legend Name the entire group. In the same form, radio buttons with the same name will be mutually exclusive, and the value indicates which item is selected.

hint: fieldset and legend provide grouping and group names for options. To select one of the two, you also need to change the two names to the same value.
